name: rail-row-chevron-actions-overlap
description: rail: a branch row's trailing disclosure chevron and the hover-revealed '...'/'+' menu must have fully disjoint, state-appropriate hit boxes at the sidebar's min (200px) and default (280px) widths, for both a session row (1 menu button) and a project row (2), with and without a right-slot occupant (timestamp/Badge/'Not started') bounding the title column's growth. The menu and the occupant share ONE grid cell (.rightSlot) and swap visibility: at rest the hidden menu must eat no clicks (issue #196's invisible-overlay mechanism), revealed it must cover the occupant and be clickable, the chevron must win its own center in BOTH states, and the slot must never be wider than max(occupant, menu) - no space reserved for the hover menu

mutation.declaration: RailRow.module.css: .actions's rest rule reverted to the opacity-only hide of the pre-2026-08 design (drop `visibility: hidden` and the visibility transition entries, keep `opacity: 0`) - geometry unchanged, hit-testing broken exactly the way issue #196's invisible overlay was
mutation.note: With the menu hidden by opacity alone it stays hit-testable at rest: every -r fixture's kebabSelfWinner resolves to "kebab" (and plusSelfWinner to "plus" on project rows), failing with 'the HIDDEN kebab trigger wins its own center at rest ... the invisible-overlay mechanism of #196' in all 9 rest fixtures, with occupant-covered failures alongside wherever an occupant exists. Restoring visibility: hidden returns every fixture to PASS. A second mutation was verified the same day: .rightSlot reverted from display:grid (shared cell) to display:flex (side-by-side) leaves hit-testing green but fails the slot-width and flush-right assertions in all 10 occupant-bearing fixtures - the slot grows to occupant + menu (measured: 37.7px vs its 23.3px widest child on a timestamp row, after the menu trigger's glyph-hugging padding landed), the reserved-space regression the shared cell removed. With the intersection assertion added, the flex mutation also fails 'the menu and the occupant share no pixels' in the revealed copies of those fixtures.
